latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the estimate-agent-revenue skill.
- Calculates monthly revenue projections for AI agents using native ads, affiliate, CPC, and lead generation models.
- Asks 5 key questions about the agent to personalize the estimate.
- Gives floor/mid/ceiling scenarios with all math shown and clear CPM/CPC/affiliate/lead-gen benchmarks.
- Highlights current Operon network demand, especially strong in crypto verticals.
- Includes actionable links for response quality scoring and SDK integration.
